title: ci(dependabot-gate): wait for Spec Main Shape Gate now that it is enrolled (objectui#9969)
body:
Fixes #9969
Clause-②: no

The `domain:ui` seat's half of objectui#9969's ruling A (director seat, comment `5749111530`; maintainer 「objectui#9584 + #9969 A」, comment `5750520799`). The maintainer's half was taken first: `Spec Main Shape Gate` was enrolled in ruleset 11776024 and read back on 2026-09-27 (comment `5852129691`, 「Spec Main Shape Gate 已处理，其他同意」). This PR is the second, in-tree step.

## What changes

- `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`: `'Spec Main Shape Gate'` moves from `NOT_A_GATE` to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`. The entry's prose is rewritten: both of its conditions were met before the move (the enrolment, as a dated reading that `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` re-takes; and the cleared day-one break), and the order of the two steps is recorded, with why neither order lets a red through. The docblock's workflow-to-check inventory gains the `spec-main-shape-gate.yml` row.
- `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`: the context joins `WATCHED_CONTEXTS`, not `PINNED_CONTEXTS` (reasons under Measurement 2).
- Tests: `dependabot-merge-gate.test.ts` gains a named block that pins the move, with a control. `check-required-check-set.test.ts` gets a new control fixture `ruling-9969.json` (objectui#9499's set plus this one context), an updated `type-check-removed.json` (the control minus `Type Check`, as before), and a case that reads the declared set with this context lost. The existing `ruling-9499.json` is kept, because it is now exactly that case.
- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: the inventory row said "No, not yet ... classifies it `NOT_A_GATE`", and the section was headed "Why it is not a required check yet". This change makes both false, so they are updated, and the doc test's declared-reason prose for that section follows. ⚠️ **This is outside the claim's file surface** (`scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` and `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` plus their tests). It is here because this change is what makes those sentences false. No published package, no `.github/workflows/**` edit.

## Measurement 1: the ruling's unmeasured point, "what the script does when the name is in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` and the ruleset does not list it"

Measured with the committed module (`5d96da240`) against the pre-change module from `bff63cc12`, using a harness in the dev's scratchpad (not committed):

- **The ruleset is not one of the gate's inputs.** `main()` was run through `createChecksApi` with a fetch stub that records every URL. It requested exactly one route shape, `/repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/commits/SHA/check-runs?filter=latest&per_page=100&page=1`, and nothing under `/rules` or `/branches/.../protection`. So once the name is in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, the gate behaves the same whether or not the ruleset lists the context.
- **Real snapshots, old module vs new.** 12 real PR heads from the last 100 `Spec Main Shape Gate` runs, all with the check at `completed/success`: OLD `green`, NEW `green` on 12/12. This check was the last required context to report on 2 of the 12, which moved the gate's green instant by +5 s and +77 s. On the other 10 it moved nothing. For scale, the workflow's own runs over that window took a median of 12.0 min on `pull_request` (max 13.3 min, 61 runs), against the gate's 40-minute deadline (`GATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: '2400'`).
- **The same real snapshot with only this check varied:** `failure` gives OLD `green` and NEW `red`, failing `Spec Main Shape Gate (failure)`. `absent` gives OLD `green` and NEW `pending`, missing it; through `waitForGate` with a fake clock and the 40-minute deadline, that becomes `red`, `timedOut: true` after 121 polls. `in_progress` gives OLD `green` and NEW `pending`.
- ⇒ **The two half-states.** Name in the list with the ruleset silent: the Dependabot lane would be stricter than the queue, never looser. It waits for the check and refuses it when it is red or never reports. Ruleset listing it with the name absent (the state since the 2026-09-27 enrolment, until this merges): the Dependabot gate could enable auto-merge without waiting, and the queue build (where the ruleset requires the context, and the workflow subscribes `merge_group`) would still refuse a red. Exposure in that window: **0 open Dependabot PRs**. Checked with `GET /issues?state=open&creator=dependabot[bot]`, which returned 0; the control query `state=all` with the same filter returned #8940, #8939 and #8683 (all closed), so the filter works. The order ruling A asked for, ruleset first and this line second, is the order that happened.
- **NOT MEASURED: a `Spec Main Shape Gate` run on a Dependabot head.** No Dependabot PR has produced one yet. The workflow's run list filtered to `actor=dependabot[bot]` has `total_count: 0`. The newest Dependabot-actor run of `dependabot-auto-merge.yml` is from 2026-09-12, and this workflow first ran on 2026-09-18. Why it should run there: the `pull_request` trigger has no path filter, the job has no actor `if:`, and the only secret it uses is `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` under `contents: read`. If it does not run, the failure is closed: the gate times out `red`, nothing merges, and the PR carries a red check naming `Spec Main Shape Gate (never reported)`.

## Measurement 2: should `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` pin the new context?

- Before this change the patrol pinned `Type Check` and watched 5 contexts. The live run on 2026-09-27 (`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`, exit 0) read `DRIFTED`, listing `Spec Main Shape Gate` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` as "required but not declared".
- I took that live answer and removed `Spec Main Shape Gate`. The **old** patrol only drops the name from its "not declared" list: exit 0, and nothing names the loss. The **new** patrol prints ``No longer required: `Spec Main Shape Gate`.``, also exit 0. So watching it is what makes losing it from the ruleset visible, which is what the triage note asked for.
- **Watched, not pinned.** Pinning would add a new red leg, and the patrol's own header makes promotion to `PINNED_CONTEXTS` "a maintainer's call, not a tidy-up". New gates default to no, so it is watched only: a loss is reported and exits 0. No new red is introduced.
- After the change, the live read is still `DRIFTED`, with 1 undeclared context (`Governed Surface Queue Guard`). That context is outside this card; see the acceptance notes.

## Readings taken before any edit

- `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main` at 2026-09-27T15:10Z: the `required_status_checks` rule of ruleset 11776024 lists 8 contexts, including `Spec Main Shape Gate`.
- Latest `Spec Main Shape Gate` check run on the `main` head `dac022c4e`: `completed/success` (merge-queue build). The last 100 workflow runs had 0 failures (61 `pull_request` success, 34 `merge_group` success, 3 cancelled, 2 in progress).

## Tests and gates (all at head `5d96da240`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the five core files (`dependabot-merge-gate`, `check-required-check-set`, `merge-queue-reporting`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `spec-main-shape-gate`), under the verify lock: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 200 passed (200)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Every `scripts/__tests__/*.test.ts` that names either script or the CI/CD guide (26 files, from `git grep -l`), plus `spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts` and `scripts-type-check.test.ts`: `Test Files 28 passed (28)`, `Tests 1182 passed (1182)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` (`tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` confirms both scripts and all three edited test files are in the program.
- `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs --self-test`: `32 cases pass`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.", exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`, exit 0.
- `check-control-bytes`, `check-doc-links`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-doc-fence-languages` and `check-doc-example-ids`: all exit 0.
- ESLint on the 5 touched `.mjs` and `.ts` files with `--no-inline-config --format json`: 5 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored. `eslint.config.js` does not enable type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide lint belongs to CI.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 8 changed paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.

## Ablations (one-off, both through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run on the committed head)

- **A:** delete the `'Spec Main Shape Gate',` line from `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `e10ecb0` → `5e53694`, on-disk count 0). **6 failed**: the 4 cases of the new block, the partition case `classifies every produced check exactly once`, and the patrol's `every pinned and watched name is declared blocking in REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`. The restore was proven: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. ⚠️ My first attempt used an anchor whose replacement text already existed in the file, so the tool refused it (count rose by 0) and restored. That attempt ran nothing and is not counted.
- **B:** delete the name from `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `c809136` → `1c38467`). **4 failed**: the CLI control on `ruling-9969.json`, `declares exactly the contexts the patrol pins and watches`, the dated drift case, and the new "lost ... naming it" case. Restore proven the same way.

## Acceptance notes (observed, out of scope, not fixed here)

- `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml`: its header still says "This context is REQUIRABLE, and it is not REQUIRED" and "classifies it ... in `NOT_A_GATE` until a maintainer enrols it there", and it has a section headed "Why `merge_group` is subscribed although this context is NOT required yet". The enrolment made the first claim false, and this PR completes the second. The dispatch forbade edits under `.github/workflows/**`, so the text is left as it is. Carrier: none.
- `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is listed by the ruleset (read above) but is not in the patrol's `WATCHED_CONTEXTS`, so the patrol keeps reading `DRIFTED`. objectui#6596 is closed. The objectui `AGENTS.md` sentence saying that context is not yet a required context is governed surface. Carrier: none.
- In `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, the `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` docblock still says "The four shards are spelled out individually on purpose", which the inline comment at `'Test'` has contradicted since objectui#9499. In the CI/CD guide, the patrol section says `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` "is the other eight". Both were stale before this change and are not touched here. Carrier: none.
